title: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi (Government of India)
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
text: PM-KISAN provides income support to eligible landholding farmer families. Eligibility requires cultivable land in the applicant's name in land records, Aadhaar-seeded bank account, and e-KYC completion. Exclusions include institutional landholders, serving or retired government employees except Group D or multitasking staff, income tax payers, and professionals such as doctors and engineers. Required documents: land records such as passbook or khata, Aadhaar card, bank account details, and mobile number for e-KYC. Farmers can check beneficiary status and instalment history on the PM-KISAN portal using Aadhaar or bank account number. New registrations are done through the portal or at Common Service Centres with document verification by the state agriculture department.
